chapter: Leading the band after Chick Webb, 1939-40
title: West Coast tour: Sweet's ballrooms, Portland key to the city
summary: After the Trianon the band played Oakland, Seattle and Portland, met Fats Waller, and Ella gave a moving medley.

bands.name: Ella Fitzgerald and Her Famous Orchestra

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: He stayed with us a little while. (Inaudible). I think I left him in the band. When I came back from the coast with the band, I played the

Apollo Theater.
Then I went back to Boston.
All right, now, this is with the band?
Yeah.

Okay.
How long were you on the coast?

Oh, we were on the coast about a month. We played up and down the coast.
Ella had to make a picture for a week.
Then we went in the Trianon Ballroom for about a week or two weeks.
Then we went up to the Golden Gate Theater in San Francisco. We played all the way up.
We played the Sweets -- (inaudible) place called the Sweets Ballroom. He had ballrooms like in California, Oakland -- right straight up.
We played about five or six of his ballrooms. In fact, we met Fats Waller in Oakland.
And my brother was there.
My brother, Dave, played with sax with

S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC.
WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943
him. With Fats Waller. (inaudible). And we met him in Oakland.
Did you --

It was a hot night and we went to see -- we was going to stop over and see Fats Waller. And it was a real hot night. This night was something else. We stopped over to the ballroom where Sweets, because we're going to play that ballroom coming back. We were going up to Seattle, Washington to play --
I was going to ask you if you --
We went to Seattle, Washington and played for about a couple of weeks around there. We played some one nighters at (inaudible) Theater.
You play in Oregon -- Eugene Portland or (inaudible)?
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943

Yeah, we played Portland. Oh, we -- oh, Portland, oh, what a beautiful city. They gave us the key to the city. Brought Ella down, the mayor came out and gave us the key to the city in Portland, Oregon. I'll never forget that.
At Seattle, do you remember the name of the establishment in Seattle? (TRIVANON)
We played Sweets Ballroom.
Sweets had a ballroom in Seattle?
Sweets had a ballroom in Oakland, too.
I see. So he had a chain, you might say.

That was one of the nights that Ella really pulled. Everybody was in Portland. One night there, around about 11 or 12 o'clock, she started singing (medley of things (unintelligible)), and she had everybody in the ballroom in tears. She was singing her heart out that night. That's one of those nights -- I guess she
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943

was thinking about Chick. I guess something just hit her (inaudible). Boy, this was about a half hour, and the ballroom was just as quiet, and Ella was going through all these songs. People was just (inaudible). She just tore the place up. Then we left and went -- The next day they gave her the key we brought the band down to the city (inaudible). And then we went up to Seattle, Washington and played the ballroom up there.
Then you went back --

Then we came back down and played Oakland. We played at the ballroom. Now we're going back to California. Now when we're in California, we was playing -- that's when we was going back to do something. Play the Paramount Theater -- play the theater in California. See, when we first went to California, we played the Trianon Ballroom for two weeks. Then we -- Ella made the picture, then we left to do that

tour at Sweets Ballroom all the way up to Seattle and back.
